cell.label: Suspected adrenal insufficiency: Is the morning cortisol level above 300 nmol/L?
Has the patient used corticosteroids in the past year?
Administer 250 mcg cosyntropin and measure cortisol level 30 to 60 minutes later. Is the serum cortisol above 500 nmol/L?
Adrenal insufficiency ruled out clinical follow-up
Administer 250 mcg cosyntropin and measure cortisol level 30 to 60 minutes later. Is the serum cortisol above 500 nmol/L?
Is the morning plasma ACTH elevated?
Secondary adrenal insufficiency. Work up for hypothalamic-pituitary disease (eg, pituitary adenoma)
Severe adrenal insufficiency ruled out. Do you suspect mild adrenal insufficiency?
Are the ACTH, insulin tolerance and metyrapone test results normal?
